notes: Kimi enforces ~1024px minimum resolution on shortest side.
Transparent bg supported for: 1:1, 3:2, 2:3 ratios only.
All outputs go through normalize pipeline before game use.
Row order for 4-dir: Down, Up, Left, Right (top to bottom).
Row order for 2-dir: Left, Right (top to bottom).
LEFT means character faces/walks toward the LEFT side of the image.
RIGHT means character faces/walks toward the RIGHT side of the image.
pipeline: 6. Review QA outputs, accept when satisfied

style_header.text:
Style: high-quality pixel art, cozy farming sim aesthetic, Greek mythology theme.
Motifs: white marble, bronze statuary, sacred island flora, coastal ruins.
No anti-aliasing. Crisp pixel edges. Consistent outline thickness.
Flat/cluster shading. No blurry gradients.
Keep lighting consistent across all frames.
Match exact character proportions in every frame.
Align all frames on same baseline.
Same character identity in each frame.

circe.name: Circe
circe.read: Graceful, intelligent, emotionally heavy but not fragile.
circe.silhouette: Long dark hair, flowing dress, subtle jewelry accents.
circe.outfit: Deep violet/purple dress with warm gold details (Greek-inspired trim, small circlet or ornament).

palette.dress: Deep violet + shadow plum + muted highlight lavender
palette.hair: Dark brown/near-black with subtle warm highlights

circe.direction_notes: Down: strongest facial read. Up: same hair mass and shoulder width. Left/Right: dress flow and hair volume consistent.

hermes.name: Hermes
hermes.role: NPC. Messenger god, witty guide, sarcastic but helpful.
hermes.silhouette: Short tousled light hair, light tunic/cloak, messenger-like trim.
hermes.outfit: Pale sky-blue/cream garments with gold accents; optional small wing motifs on sandals.
hermes.direction_notes: Keep narrower/lighter than Circe in silhouette. Avoid heavy armor or warrior reads.

scylla.name: Scylla (Monster Form)
scylla.role: NPC. Tragic transformed figure, emotionally central to ending.
scylla.read: Monstrous and dangerous, but clearly tragic rather than generic evil.
scylla.silhouette: Broad distorted upper mass with multi-head suggestion; unstable asymmetry acceptable.
scylla.form: Sea-monster anatomy with human-remnant cues; simplify head count to readable grouped forms.

palette.accents: Bruised purple or cold cyan highlights

scylla.direction_notes: Maintain same monster mass across all directions. Do not let side views collapse into generic blob.

pig.name: Pig
pig.read: Cozy domesticated farm pig, stylized to match character world.

palette.body: Warm pink/rose tones with earthy shadow tones

pig.shape: Rounded, friendly, readable at small scale.
pig.direction_notes: Keep proportions and snout/ear shape identical across all sheets.

assets.description: Aiaia island tileset. Warm, sunny, fertile garden island.
required_tiles: Row 0-1: Grass variants (5+ types), dirt path, path edges/transitions
Row 2-3: Ground textures — flowers, garden soil, stone path, mixed grass/dirt
Row 4-5: Garden features — hedges, flower beds, herb garden borders, small rocks
Row 6-7: Architecture — marble floor tiles, column bases, low walls, steps
assets.style_note: Warm palette. Greens, warm yellows, golden browns, white marble accents. Cozy Greek island garden.

assets.description: Scylla's Cove tileset. Dark, foreboding coastal rocks.
required_tiles: Row 0-1: Dark shoreline — wet rocks, tide pools, dark sand transitions
Row 2-3: Dark ground — rocky surfaces, cracked stone, deep shadow ground variants
Row 4-5: Coastal features — barnacle rocks, seaweed patches, bone fragments, coral
Row 6-7: Cave/cliff elements — dark wall faces, cave mouth edges, dripping stone
assets.style_note: Cold palette. Deep blue-grays, teal shadows, dark purple-blacks. Menacing but not cartoonish.

assets.description: Greek architectural decoration tileset. Overlay props for both zones.
required_tiles: Row 0-1: Marble path tiles (4+ variants), stone borders, paving patterns
Row 2-3: Column pieces — base, shaft, capital, broken column, fallen column
Row 3-4: Statues — bronze statue base, full small statue, cracked/ruined statue parts
Row 4-5: Ruins — broken wall, archway pieces, scattered rubble, mosaic fragments
Row 6-7: Nature/sacred — sacred grove tree, laurel bush, offering bowl, torch/brazier
assets.style_note: White marble, warm bronze, aged stone. Props should work overlaid on both Aiaia and Scylla tilesets.

assets.description: Circe on Aiaia. A divine but isolated woman on a lush green island. Mediterranean setting. Golden light. She stands amid herbs and wild plants, beautiful but alone. Portrait composition.
assets.style_note: Painterly/illustrative style, NOT pixel art. Full-frame artwork. Warm, melancholic mood.

assets.description: Pharmaka/herb craft. Close-up of hands working with glowing herbs, mortar and pestle, mysterious plant essences. Magical green and gold light. The art of herbal magic.
assets.style_note: Painterly. Intimate, magical atmosphere. Focus on the craft.

assets.description: Love triangle. Circe watching Glaucus (sea-god, blue-green tones) who gazes at Scylla (beautiful human woman, dark hair). Circe's jealousy visible in her expression. Coastal setting.
assets.style_note: Painterly. Romantic tension. Warm vs cool color contrast between characters.

assets.description: The poisoning. Circe pouring dark liquid poison into a bathing pool at night. Ominous green-purple liquid spreading through water. Guilty, determined expression. Dark and foreboding.
assets.style_note: Painterly. Dark, tense, regretful mood. Poison should look viscerally wrong.

assets.description: Scylla's transformation. A woman mid-transformation into a sea monster. Multiple heads emerging, human form distorting. Horror and tragedy. The moment of irreversible change.
assets.style_note: Painterly. Body horror but tasteful — tragic, not gory. Should evoke pity.

assets.description: Exile and guilt. Circe alone on Aiaia, staring at the sea toward the distant strait. Slumped posture. Sunset or overcast sky. Weight of guilt visible. Empty island around her.
Fragile hope. Circe holding a single golden moly seedling, looking at it with careful hope. Warm dawn light breaking through. The beginning of her attempt to make things right.
assets.style_note: Painterly. Hopeful but fragile. Golden light, green growth. The emotional turn.
